newsitem.title: USA: Female Health inks global condom price pact.
newsitem.headline: Female Health inks global condom price pact.

text.p: Female Health Co said Monday it signed a three-year agreement to sell its female condom at a discount price to members of the United Nations.

The pact allows each of the program's 160 UN member states to buy the female condom in bulk as part of an education and marketing effort supported by Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS). About 80 nations have already expressed interest in the program, said Female Health.
The company holds worldwide rights to the condom, which it sells in North America, Japan, China and the European Union.
